notes.title: Demo Release & Tokyo Game Dungeon Booth! 🧀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44501793/7583bd6335a50f2a8bbd6a69855fdd7a6611bd55.png[/img]

Even during the holidays, gather your friends and join the hardworking mice at the black company!

To celebrate our Tokyo Game Dungeon 8 appearance, the demo will be available for one week starting today, 5/4!

Packed with fun gimmicks!
Even during the holidays, gather your friends and work at the mouse black company!

notes.title: Welcome to the wonderful mouse company🧀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44501793/607fca5dac1ecb4962d9ee5438f71308042ed2e9.jpg[/img]

Due to a major update in preparation for the TGS exhibit, we will be releasing a trial version for a limited time of 2 weeks from today, September 26th!

The time limit function and graphics have been significantly updated!
Please give it a try 🧀!
